title: AtlasPin
description: AtlasPin is a modern, intuitive plugin for managing coordinates on a Minecraft server. It allows players and administrators to create, manage, and share pins using beautiful graphical interface templates and high performance.
body:
# AtlasPin - Advanced Waypoint System for Minecraft

> A powerful, modern, and lightweight waypoint plugin designed for
> performance, usability, and beautiful player experience.

AtlasPin allows players and administrators to easily create, manage, and
share important locations using a fully interactive GUI with advanced
performance and clean design.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ✨ Core Features

## 📍 Advanced Waypoint System

AtlasPin provides a flexible and powerful waypoint system:

-   📌 11 built‑in waypoint templates
-   📝 Fully customizable waypoint creation
-   🌍 Public waypoints (visible to all players)
-   🔒 Private waypoints (personal waypoints)
-   📋 One‑click coordinate copying
-   📚 Organized and paginated browsing
-   ⚡ Instant GUI interaction

Supported templates include:

-   End Portal
-   Stronghold
-   Village
-   Nether Portal
-   Base
-   Farm
-   Resource Location
-   Custom Locations

![Type](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5cvwporI/images/78f1890809e0b0e157240dbefe28783109645c37.jpeg)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 🎨 Modern and Beautiful GUI

AtlasPin uses a fully graphical interface instead of chat commands.

Features:

-   Fully interactive inventory GUI
-   Modern purple gradient theme
-   Clean and professional layout
-   Custom waypoint icons
-   Smooth page navigation
-   No chat spam

Designed for maximum usability and visual clarity.

![Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5cvwporI/images/2f9f072763bdc4e66763da1b364411283510c456.jpeg)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 🌍 Multi‑Language Support

AtlasPin includes a flexible localization system.

### Included languages

-   🇺🇸 English
-   🇷🇺 Russian

### Additional capabilities

-   Easy custom language creation
-   Fully localized GUI and messages
-   Live language reload support
-   No server restart required

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 👑 Admin Control Panel

AtlasPin includes powerful moderation tools.

Administrators can:

-   View all waypoints on the server
-   Teleport to any waypoint instantly
-   Delete any waypoint
-   Reload configuration safely
-   Moderate player waypoint usage

Perfect for both small and large servers.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## ⚡ Performance and Stability

AtlasPin is designed for high performance environments.

Technical features:

-   SQLite database
-   HikariCP connection pooling
-   Fully asynchronous database operations
-   Zero main thread blocking
-   Lightweight and optimized
-   No external dependencies

Safe for large servers with many players.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 🎮 Commands

``` markdown
/pin
```

Opens the main waypoint menu

``` markdown
/pin admin
```

Opens the admin control panel

``` markdown
/pin reload
```

Reloads configuration and language files

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 🔁 Command Aliases

``` markdown
/atlaspin
/notes
/wp
```

All aliases function identically to `/pin`.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 🔐 Permissions

``` markdown
AtlasPin.use
```

Allows access to the main waypoint menu

``` markdown
AtlasPin.create
```

Allows waypoint creation

``` markdown
AtlasPin.admin
```

Allows access to admin features

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ⚙️ Configuration Example

``` yaml
language: "en"

max_notes_per_player: 50

```

Configuration can be reloaded without restarting the server.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 🎯 Recommended Server Types

AtlasPin works perfectly with:

-   Survival servers
-   SMP servers
-   RPG servers
-   Community servers
-   Private servers
-   Public networks

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 🚀 Why Choose AtlasPin

AtlasPin provides a modern waypoint experience with:

-   Beautiful GUI
-   Excellent performance
-   Easy installation
-   Powerful admin tools
-   Clean and professional design
-   Lightweight architecture

Built for modern Minecraft servers.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 📊 Statistics

AtlasPin uses bStats to collect anonymous statistics for improving the
plugin.
